sources.evidence: Page titled 'MCPC 2017 @ UCSY, Myanmar' announcing the Myanmar Collegiate Programming Contest 2017 with registration dates, rehearsal day 25 October and contest day 26 October 2017.
PDF of 15 pages titled 'Myanmar Collegiate Programming Contest 2017 Problem Set' listing problems A to J and dated October 26, 2017.

myanmar-mcpc-2018.notes: Website (s1) states contest day 11 August 2018; the standings page and problem set are dated 18 August 2018 (pack date 2018-08-18).

sources.evidence: Single page titled 2018 Myanmar Collegiate Programming Contest (MCPC 2018), hosted by the University of Computer Studies, Yangon, with dates, environment and rules.
Page headed Myanmar Collegiate Programming Contest 2018 (MCPC2018) Final Standing with a 71-team table, columns A to J.
14-page PDF titled Myanmar Collegiate Programming Contest 2018 Problem Set with ten problems A to J.

myanmar-mcpc-2019.notes: Pack location says Philippines; both pages are by UCSY Yangon.

sources.evidence: Single page titled 2019 Myanmar Collegiate Programming Contest (MCPC 2019), hosted by the University of Computer Studies, Yangon, with contest day 18 October 2019.
Page headed 2019 Myanmar Collegiate Programming Contest, hosted by UCSY (October 18, 2019), with an 85-team table and columns A to J.
